items.title: Define the frozen-claim snapshot record and a deterministic claim-normalization Fn
items.context: Add a snapshot/binding record for a checklist userSees claim: { normalizedClaimDigest, materialHash, headHash, attestedAt, attestedBy? }. Reuse existing freshness primitives (currentMaterialHash / checkEvidenceFreshnessForGit in handlers/checklist.ts; storyFilesHash from B-5a9a). normalizeClaim is a pure Fn: trim, collapse internal whitespace runs to one space, strip trailing whitespace — deterministic, no semantic interpretation. Types in core/types.ts; normalize + sha256 digest in a pure fn module (no I/O).
items.userSees: A developer runs the new smoke and sees "normalizeClaim collapses whitespace deterministically" and "snapshot record binds {normalizedClaimDigest, materialHash, headHash}" among the passing assertions.

happy.desc: normalizeClaim collapses arbitrary whitespace (tabs, repeated spaces, leading/trailing) to a canonical form deterministically

edge.desc: empty or whitespace-only userSees normalizes to empty and yields a stable digest without throwing

adversarial.desc: two userSees differing only in whitespace yield an IDENTICAL digest (no false drift); differing by one non-whitespace char yields a DIFFERENT digest

items.title: Snapshot userSees at attestation time and detect bidirectional drift (claim OR material), classify legacy-unbound
items.context: Capture the snapshot when a checklist item's userSees becomes an attested delivered claim (PLAN pins the exact hook; candidate: on checklist_update status=done). Detect drift by recomputing the normalized digest and re-checking material freshness: drift when normalizedClaimDigest changed (claim edited) OR the bound material is stale (rename-aware `git diff --name-status -M`, mirroring review_incremental_context). A userSees with no snapshot is classified legacy-unbound (not drift, not error). Pure detection Fn + handler wiring; NO gate blocking in this story.
items.userSees: A developer runs the smoke and sees "material drift under frozen userSees -> FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT", "userSees text edited -> FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT", "unrelated file change -> no drift", and "userSees with no snapshot -> legacy-unbound".

happy.desc: after userSees is snapshotted at status=done, mutating story-owned material makes detectDrift report driftKind=material with actionRequired=re_attestation

edge.desc: a userSees with no snapshot is classified legacy-unbound (not drift, not error); an unrelated non-story-owned file change produces NO drift

adversarial.desc: editing userSees text after delivery (non-whitespace) is detected as driftKind=claim even with material unchanged; a whitespace-only userSees edit produces NO drift

items.title: Surface drift as a structured, non-blocking FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory at a read point
items.context: Expose a read-only structured report: { code: 'FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT', claimRef, itemId, previousDigest, currentDigest, previousMaterialHash, currentMaterialHash, driftKind: 'claim'|'material'|'both', classification: 'bound'|'legacy-unbound', actionRequired: 're_attestation' }. Surface via a new read-only CLI (e.g. frozen_claim_drift_check --storyId) and/or fold into story_get, mirroring the B-d243/B-edf1 storyFilesHash drift-advisory. NON-blocking in Phase 1 (no recovery path yet; a gate now would wedge stories). Follow the Handler runtime-revalidation convention — re-check every schema constraint at each consumer at runtime, not only in Zod.
items.userSees: A developer runs `lattice frozen_claim_drift_check --storyId=B-xxxx` on a story with drifted userSees and sees a JSON advisory carrying code FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT, driftKind, and actionRequired: re_attestation; a clean story reports zero drift and exits 0.

happy.desc: frozen_claim_drift_check --storyId prints the structured FROZEN_CLAIM_DRIFT advisory (code, claimRef, driftKind, actionRequired, classification) for a drifted story and a clean report for a clean story

edge.desc: the command is read-only: it writes no evidence or files and exits 0 for both clean and drifted stories

adversarial.desc: the advisory never changes a gate verdict: running it against a drifted story does not fail review, delivery, or DONE gates (Phase 1 non-blocking invariant)

items.title: RED-first smoke covering both false-positive guards; register in validate + package.json
items.context: RED-first, deterministic (no live network). Cover: (1) material drift under a frozen userSees -> detected; (2) userSees text edited -> detected; (3) unrelated file change -> NO drift (false-positive guard); (4) whitespace-only userSees edit normalizes to NO drift (false-positive guard); (5) userSees with no snapshot -> legacy-unbound. Assert the advisory is NON-blocking (does not fail any gate) in Phase 1. Register the smoke in lattice.config.json validate.commands and package.json scripts.
items.userSees: `lattice validate` runs the new frozen-claim-drift smoke and reports it green among the validate commands; the smoke output shows all five cases including the two false-positive guards passing.

happy.desc: the frozen-claim-drift smoke runs under `node bin/lattice.js validate` and reports green, covering all five cases

edge.desc: the two false-positive guards (unrelated-file change and whitespace-only edit both produce NO drift) are explicit assertions in the smoke

adversarial.desc: the smoke is deterministic and offline (no live network, no live claude -p) so it cannot flake in CI
